name: What factors influence the cost of an ADU foundation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of an ADU foundation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an ADU foundation is influenced by several factors, including the type of foundation (slab-on-grade, crawl space, or raised), the size of the ADU, site accessibility, and soil conditions. Excavation requirements, the need for retaining walls on sloped sites, and material choices also play a role. For example, a complex site with poor soil may require more extensive engineering and materials, increasing overall costs compared to a simple slab-on-grade on level ground.
acceptedAnswer.description: ADU foundation costs are influenced by type, size, site accessibility, soil conditions, and excavation needs.
